name: Things 3
tagline: Premium GTD-inspired task manager exclusive to Apple devices
painPoints: Apple-only: no Android, Windows, or Linux support
One-time purchase model means no ongoing updates without buying new versions
No AI features or automation of any kind
No email or calendar integration beyond basic system calendar sync
Beautiful but entirely manual — you manage your tasks, not an AI
metaDescription: Looking for a Things 3 alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across 50+ tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Things 3 is a masterclass in task manager design — clean, fast, and opinionated in the best way. But it is stuck in a manual, Apple-only world. There is no AI, no email integration, no cross-platform access, and no automation. Users who switch to Android, move to Windows, or simply want their task manager to do more than store GTD-style lists consistently look for alternatives that combine the simplicity of Things with the intelligence of modern AI.
gaiaReplaces: Cross-platform task management on any device or OS
Natural language task creation via conversation
Email-to-task automation replacing manual inbox processing
AI-driven prioritization replacing GTD-style manual area sorting
gaiaAdvantages: Works on Windows, Linux, Android, and web: not Apple-only
Proactive AI eliminates manual task triage and entry
Email integration connects inbox to task list automatically
Source-available and self-hostable for data privacy
Free tier available; no one-time Apple-ecosystem purchase required
migrationSteps: Export tasks from Things 3 via the File > Export menu
Import tasks into GAIA's task manager or connected Todoist account
Connect Gmail for automatic task creation from email
Download GAIA apps on your non-Apple devices

faqs.question: Does GAIA match Things 3's design quality?
faqs.answer: Things 3 sets the bar for task manager aesthetics. GAIA's interface is clean and modern but optimized for conversational interaction and proactive intelligence rather than GTD visual organization.

faqs.question: Can GAIA work on Android and Windows like Things 3 cannot?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA has cross-platform apps including Android, web, desktop (Windows and macOS), and bot interfaces. Things 3 is limited to Mac, iPhone, and iPad.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support GTD methodology like Things 3?
faqs.answer: GAIA supports organizing tasks by project and priority, which can support GTD workflows. It does not enforce a specific GTD structure, instead using AI to surface the right tasks at the right time.

faqs.question: Is GAIA free compared to Things 3's paid one-time cost?
faqs.answer: Things 3 is a paid one-time purchase per Apple platform. GAIA has a free tier, and self-hosting is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs). The Pro plan at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month is ongoing but includes AI and all integrations.
